items.title: 1.2 Units ka bain-ul-aqwami nizam (International System of Units) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.2 with Tables 1.1 to 1.3 and the sixteen conventions (PDF 5-8).

blocks.text: 1960 mein ek bain-ul-aqwami committee ne physical quantities bayan karne ke liye tareefon aur standards ke ek set par ittefaq kiya; qaim hone wala nizam System International (SI) kehlata hai. SI units duniya ki scientific community aur taqreeban sab qaumein istemal karti hain. SI do qism ke units par mushtamil hai: base units aur derived units.

Saat base units hain: length, mass, time, temperature, electric current, roshni ya luminous intensity, aur madde ki miqdar (amount of substance, zarraat ki tadaad ke khaas hawale se) ke liye. Chhoti ya bari miqdarein bayan karne ko in ke saath milli, micro aur kilo jaise prefixes istemal ho sakte hain.
Derived units woh hain jo base units par munhasir hain. Plane angle aur solid angle ke units 1995 se derived units ki fehrist mein shamil hain.

Base aur derived units ke ilawa SI kuch izafi units ki ijazat deta hai: zawiyon (angles) ke rawayati riyazi units (degree, arcminute aur arcsecond); waqt ke rawayati units (minute, hour, day aur year); logarithmic unit bel aur us ke multiples jaise decibel; rozmarra zindagi ke do metric units, volume ke liye litre aur bare masses ke liye tonne (metric ton); do ghair-metric scientific units, atomic mass unit (u) aur electron volt (eV); nautical mile aur knot, jo samandar aur meteorology mein istemal hote hain; zameen ke raqbe ke liye acre aur hectare; bar, dabao (pressure) ka unit jo meteorology mein millibar aur engineering mein kilobar ke taur par istemal hota hai; aur angstrom aur barn, jo physics aur astronomy mein istemal hote hain.

Adad standard form mein likhe jate hain jise scientific notation kehte hain, jo das ki taqaton (powers of ten) ka istemal karti hai; bain-ul-aqwami taur par qabool shuda tareeqa yeh hai ke decimal ke baen sirf ek ghair-sifr hindsa ho. Yun 134.7 ko 1.347 x 10^2 aur 0.0023 ko 2.3 x 10^-3 likha jata hai. Zyada tar prefixes 1000 ke qadmon mein order of magnitude batate hain aur bare aur chhote adad likhne aur ghair-aham hindse hatane ka aasan tareeqa dete hain; SI mein SI se pehle ke rawaj ke chaar aur prefixes bhi shamil hain: centi (10^-2), deci (10^-1), deca (10^1) aur hecto (10^2).

blocks.long_description: SI ke saat base units hain, metre, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, candela aur mole, aur un se bane derived units jaise newton, joule, watt, coulomb aur pascal, jin mein radian aur steradian 1995 se derived gine jate hain. Prefixes atto se exa tak hazaar ke qadam batate hain, purane rawaj se centi, deci, deca aur hecto ke saath, aur scientific notation decimal se pehle ek ghair-sifr hindsa rakhti hai. Likhne ke qawaid har unit ka ek symbol seedhe type mein, naam aur symbols chhote harfon mein siwaye scientists ke naam aur litre ke, koi jama ya full stop nahi, prefix unit se jura, adad aur symbol ke darmiyan space, koi compound prefix nahi, power poore multiple par, solidus ke bajaye manfi index, naam aur symbols ka koi milap nahi, amali kaam instrument ke unit mein magar aakhri nataij base units mein, aur koi CGS unit nahi, tay karte hain.

blocks.text: SI units istemal karne ke qawaid

items: Har SI unit ka ek symbol hota hai, ikhtisar (abbreviation) nahi, aur symbols sab zabanon mein ek jaise hain: ampere ke liye A, amp nahi; second ke liye s, sec nahi; SI, S.I. nahi.
Unit ka poora naam bare harf se shuru nahi hota: newton, metre, siwaye Celsius ke.
Symbols chhote harfon mein hote hain: metre ke liye m, second ke liye s, litre ke liye L istisna hai.
Scientists ke naam par symbols ka pehla harf bara hota hai: newton ke liye N, pascal ke liye Pa, watt ke liye W.
Symbols aur prefixes aas paas ke type style se qata nazar seedhe (roman) style mein chhapte hain: 50 m ka faasla.
Symbols jama (plural) nahi lete: 1 mm, 100 mm, 1 kg, 60 kg.
Symbol ke baad full stop ya nuqta nahi lagta siwaye jumle ke aakhir ke.
Prefix base unit se pehle aur baghair space likha jata hai: mL, m L nahi; ms, m s nahi.
Base units ek space ke faasle par likhe jate hain, aur adad (value) aur symbol ke darmiyan bhi space chhori jati hai: 1 kg, 10 m s^-1.
Compound prefixes ki ijazat nahi: 1 uuF ko 1 pF hona chahiye.
Jab base unit ya multiple ko power di jaye to power poore multiple par lagti hai, sirf base unit par nahi: 1 km^2 = 1 (km)^2 = 1 x (10^3 m)^2 = 1 x 10^6 m^2.
Solidus (m/s) ke bajaye manfi index notation (m s^-1) istemal karein.
Scientific notation istemal karein, decimal ke baen ek ghair-sifr hindsa: 143.7 = 1.437 x 10^2.
Ek hi expression mein symbols aur naam na milayein: metre per second ya m s^-1, metre/sec ya m/second nahi.

Amali kaam istemal hone wale instruments ke mutabiq sab se munasib units mein record ho: screw gauge ki paimaishein mm mein record hoti hain, magar aakhri nataij munasib base units mein record hone chahiye.
SI purane CGS units jaise dyne, erg, gauss, poise aur torr ki ijazat nahi deta.

blocks.text: Mass ko energy ki ek shakal samjha ja sakta hai: dar asal mass bohat ghani energy hai. Einstein ki equation E = mc^2 ka matlab energy = mass x (roshni ki raftar)^2 hai, to 1 kg mass dar haqeeqat 9 x 10^16 J energy hai (Do You Know). Masses ke order of magnitude ka side chart electron (taqreeban 10^-30 kg) se proton, uranium atom, DNA molecule, cell, machhar, kitab, car, oil tanker aur Mount Everest se hota hua Zameen aur Suraj (taqreeban 10^30 kg) tak jata hai.

blocks.prompt: 0.000 000 52 m aur 4 500 000 J ko munasib prefix ke saath scientific notation mein likhein, aur 'a force of 20 Newtons', '5 kgs', '12 m/s' aur '1 mmm' ko durust karein (short question 1.5 aur conventions ki jaanch).
blocks.explanation: 0.000 000 52 m = 5.2 x 10^-7 m = 0.52 um ya 520 nm; 4 500 000 J = 4.5 x 10^6 J = 4.5 MJ. Unit ka naam chhote harf mein aur symbol N hai, to '20 N' ya '20 newton'; symbols jama nahi lete, to '5 kg'; manfi index istemal karein, '12 m s^-1'; aur compound prefix ki ijazat nahi, to 1 mmm (milli-millimetre) ko 1 um likhna hoga.

items: SI (1960): saat base units (m, kg, s, A, K, cd, mol) aur derived units (rad, sr, N, J, W, C, Pa waghaira); izafi qabool shuda units (degree, minute, hour, year, bel, litre, tonne, u, eV, nautical mile, knot, acre, hectare, bar, angstrom, barn).
Scientific notation: decimal se pehle ek ghair-sifr hindsa (1.347 x 10^2). Prefixes atto se exa tak 1000 ke qadmon mein, jama centi, deci, deca, hecto.

Solah qawaid: symbols na ke abbreviations, chhote harf siwaye scientists ke naam aur L ke, seedha type, koi jama ya full stop nahi, prefix jura hua, units ke darmiyan aur adad ke baad space, koi compound prefix nahi, power poore multiple par, m/s nahi m s^-1, naam aur symbols ka milap nahi, aakhri nataij base units mein, koi CGS unit nahi.
